public class CompatibilityOptions implements Cloneable
```

Enthält Kompatibilitätsoptionen (das heißt, die vom Benutzer auf dem **Compatibility**‑Tab des **Options**‑Dialogs in Microsoft Word eingegebenen Einstellungen).

Um mehr zu erfahren, besuchen Sie den [ Detect File Format and Check Format Compatibility ][Detect File Format and Check Format Compatibility] Dokumentationsartikel.

 **Examples:** 

Zeigt, wie das Dokument für verschiedene Versionen von Microsoft Word optimiert werden kann.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 /// 
 /// Groups all flags in a document's compatibility options object by state, then prints each group.
 ///

     ArrayList disabledOptions = new ArrayList();

     addOptionName(options.getLayoutTableRowsApart(), "LayoutTableRowsApart", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);

     addOptionName(options.getSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning(), "SwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getTransparentMetafiles(), "TransparentMetafiles", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6(), "TruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUICompat97To2003(), "UICompat97To2003", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUlTrailSpace(), "UlTrailSpace", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUnderlineTabInNumList(), "UnderlineTabInNumList", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(), "UseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAnsiKerningPairs(), "UseAnsiKerningPairs", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseFELayout(), "UseFELayout", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseNormalStyleForList(), "UseNormalStyleForList", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUsePrinterMetrics(), "UsePrinterMetrics", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells(), "UseSingleBorderforContiguousCells", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseWord2002TableStyleRules(), "UseWord2002TableStyleRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseWord2010TableStyleRules(), "UseWord2010TableStyleRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseWord97LineBreakRules(), "UseWord97LineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPJustification(), "WPJustification", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPSpaceWidth(), "WPSpaceWidth", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWrapTrailSpaces(), "WrapTrailSpaces", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");
     for (String optionName : disabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
 }

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);
     else
         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
 }

Zeigt, wie eine OOXML‑Konformitätsspezifikation für ein zu speicherndes Dokument festgelegt wird.

```

 Document doc = new Document();
 DocumentBuilder builder = new DocumentBuilder(doc);

 // If we configure compatibility options to comply with Microsoft Word 2003,
 // inserting an image will define its shape using VML.
 doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2003);
 builder.insertImage(getImageDir() + "Transparent background logo.png");

 Assert.assertEquals(ShapeMarkupLanguage.VML, ((Shape) doc.getChild(NodeType.SHAPE, 0, true)).getMarkupLanguage());

 // The "ISO/IEC 29500:2008" OOXML standard does not support VML shapes.
 // If we set the "Compliance" property of the SaveOptions object to "OoxmlCompliance.Iso29500_2008_Strict",
 // any document we save while passing this object will have to follow that standard.
 OoxmlSaveOptions saveOptions = new OoxmlSaveOptions();
 saveOptions.setCompliance(OoxmlCompliance.ISO_29500_2008_STRICT);
 saveOptions.setSaveFormat(SaveFormat.DOCX);

 doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "OoxmlSaveOptions.Iso29500Strict.docx", saveOptions);

 // Our saved document defines the shape using DML to adhere to the "ISO/IEC 29500:2008" OOXML standard.
 doc = new Document(getArtifactsDir() + "OoxmlSaveOptions.Iso29500Strict.docx");

 Assert.assertEquals(ShapeMarkupLanguage.DML, ((Shape) doc.getChild(NodeType.SHAPE, 0, true)).getMarkupLanguage());
 
```

Zeigt, wie der Textinhalt einer Textbox vertikal ausgerichtet wird.

```

 Document doc = new Document();
 DocumentBuilder builder = new DocumentBuilder(doc);

 Shape shape = builder.insertShape(ShapeType.TEXT_BOX, 200.0, 200.0);

 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Top" to
 // align the text in this text box with the top side of the shape.
 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Middle" to
 // align the text in this text box to the center of the shape.
 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Bottom" to
 // align the text in this text box to the bottom of the shape.
 shape.getTextBox().setVerticalAnchor(verticalAnchor);

 builder.moveTo(shape.getFirstParagraph());
 builder.write("Hello world!");

 // The vertical aligning of text inside text boxes is available from Microsoft Word 2007 onwards.
 doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2007);
 doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "Shape.VerticalAnchor.docx");
 
```

| [setDoNotVertAlignInTxbx(boolean value)](#setDoNotVertAlignInTxbx-boolean) | Ignorieren Sie die vertikale Ausrichtung in Textfeldern. |
| [setDoNotWrapTextWithPunct(boolean value)](#setDoNotWrapTextWithPunct-boolean) | Erlauben Sie hängende Interpunktion nicht im Zeichenraster. |
| [setFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8(boolean value)](#setFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8-boolean) | Emulieren Sie die Fußnotenanordnung von Word 6.x/95/97. |
| [setForgetLastTabAlignment(boolean value)](#setForgetLastTabAlignment-boolean) | Ignorieren Sie die Breite des letzten Tabstopps beim Ausrichten des Absatzes, wenn er nicht linksbündig ist. |
| [setGrowAutofit(boolean value)](#setGrowAutofit-boolean) | Erlauben Sie Tabellen, sich automatisch an die Seitenränder anzupassen. |
| [setLayoutRawTableWidth(boolean value)](#setLayoutRawTableWidth-boolean) | Ignorieren Sie den Abstand vor der Tabelle, wenn entschieden wird, ob die Tabelle ein schwebendes Objekt umfließen soll. |
| [setLayoutTableRowsApart(boolean value)](#setLayoutTableRowsApart-boolean) | Erlauben Sie Tabellenzeilen, Inline‑Objekte unabhängig umzubrechen. |
| [setLineWrapLikeWord6(boolean value)](#setLineWrapLikeWord6-boolean) | Emulieren Sie den Zeilenumbruch von Word 6.0 für ostasiatischen Text. |
| [setMWSmallCaps(boolean value)](#setMWSmallCaps-boolean) | Emulieren Sie Word 5.x für die Small‑Caps‑Formatierung auf dem Macintosh. |
| [setNoColumnBalance(boolean value)](#setNoColumnBalance-boolean) | Balancieren Sie Textspalten innerhalb eines Abschnitts nicht aus. |
| [setNoExtraLineSpacing(boolean value)](#setNoExtraLineSpacing-boolean) | Zentrieren Sie Inhalte nicht auf Zeilen mit exakt festgelegter Zeilenhöhe. |
| [setNoLeading(boolean value)](#setNoLeading-boolean) | Fügen Sie keinen Zeilenabstand zwischen Textzeilen hinzu. |
| [setNoSpaceRaiseLower(boolean value)](#setNoSpaceRaiseLower-boolean) | Erhöhen Sie die Zeilenhöhe nicht für hoch- oder tiefgestellten Text. |
| [setNoTabHangInd(boolean value)](#setNoTabHangInd-boolean) | Erstellen Sie keinen benutzerdefinierten Tabstopp für hängenden Einzug. |
| [setOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification(boolean value)](#setOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification-boolean) | Gibt an, wie die Stilhierarchie des Dokuments ausgewertet wird. |
| [setPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader(boolean value)](#setPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader-boolean) | Drucke Fließtext vor Kopf-/Fußzeileninhalten. |
| [setPrintColBlack(boolean value)](#setPrintColBlack-boolean) | Drucke Farben als Schwarz‑Weiß ohne Dithering. |
| [setSelectFldWithFirstOrLastChar(boolean value)](#setSelectFldWithFirstOrLastChar-boolean) | Feld auswählen, wenn das erste oder letzte Zeichen ausgewählt ist. |
| [setShapeLayoutLikeWW8(boolean value)](#setShapeLayoutLikeWW8-boolean) | Simuliere Word‑97‑Textumbruch um schwebende Objekte. |
| [setShowBreaksInFrames(boolean value)](#setShowBreaksInFrames-boolean) | Seiten‑/Spaltenumbrüche in Rahmen anzeigen. |
| [setSpaceForUL(boolean value)](#setSpaceForUL-boolean) | Zusätzlichen Abstand unter der Grundlinie für unterstrichenen ostasiatischen Text hinzufügen. |
| [setSpacingInWholePoints(boolean value)](#setSpacingInWholePoints-boolean) | Text nur um ganze Punkte erweitern/verengen. |
| [setSplitPgBreakAndParaMark(boolean value)](#setSplitPgBreakAndParaMark-boolean) | Absatzmarke immer nach einem Seitenumbruch auf die nächste Seite verschieben. |
| [setSubFontBySize(boolean value)](#setSubFontBySize-boolean) | Priorität der Schriftgröße bei Schriftartersetzung erhöhen. |
| [setSuppressBottomSpacing(boolean value)](#setSuppressBottomSpacing-boolean) | Exakte Zeilenhöhe für die letzte Zeile auf der Seite ignorieren. |
| [setSuppressSpBfAfterPgBrk(boolean value)](#setSuppressSpBfAfterPgBrk-boolean) | Kein Abstand vor der ersten Zeile nach einem Seitenumbruch verwenden. |
| [setSuppressSpacingAtTopOfPage(boolean value)](#setSuppressSpacingAtTopOfPage-boolean) | Mindestzeilenhöhe für die erste Zeile auf der Seite ignorieren. |
| [setSuppressTopSpacing(boolean value)](#setSuppressTopSpacing-boolean) | Mindest‑ und exakte Zeilenhöhe für die erste Zeile auf der Seite ignorieren. |
| [setSuppressTopSpacingWP(boolean value)](#setSuppressTopSpacingWP-boolean) | Simuliere WordPerfect 5.x‑Zeilenabstand. |
| [setSwapBordersFacingPgs(boolean value)](#setSwapBordersFacingPgs-boolean) | Absatzrahmen auf ungeraden Seiten vertauschen. |
| [setSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning(boolean value)](#setSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning-boolean) | Gibt an, innen und außen für gespiegelte Einzüge und relative Positionierung zu vertauschen. |
| [setTransparentMetafiles(boolean value)](#setTransparentMetafiles-boolean) | Gibt an, den Bereich hinter Metadatei‑Bildern nicht zu leeren. |
| [setTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6(boolean value)](#setTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6-boolean) | Simuliere WordPerfect 6.x‑Schriftgrößenberechnung. |
| [setUICompat97To2003(boolean value)](#setUICompat97To2003-boolean) | Wahr, um UI‑Funktionen zu deaktivieren, die nicht mit Word 97‑2003 kompatibel sind. |
| [setUlTrailSpace(boolean value)](#setUlTrailSpace-boolean) | Alle nachfolgenden Leerzeichen unterstreichen. |
| [setUnderlineTabInNumList(boolean value)](#setUnderlineTabInNumList-boolean) | Nachfolgendes Zeichen nach der Nummerierung unterstreichen. |
| [setUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(boolean value)](#setUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules-boolean) | Alternatives Set von Zeilenumbruchregeln für Ostasien verwenden. |
| [setUseAnsiKerningPairs(boolean value)](#setUseAnsiKerningPairs-boolean) | ANSI‑Kerning‑Paare aus Schriftarten verwenden. |
| [setUseFELayout(boolean value)](#setUseFELayout-boolean) | Ostasien‑/Komplex‑Skript‑Layout‑Code nicht umgehen. |
| [setUseNormalStyleForList(boolean value)](#setUseNormalStyleForList-boolean) | Listenabsatzformat nicht automatisch auf Aufzählungs‑/Nummerierungstext anwenden. |
| [setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value)](#setUsePrinterMetrics-boolean) | Druckermetriken verwenden, um Dokumente anzuzeigen. |
| [setUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells(boolean value)](#setUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells-boolean) | Vereinfachte Regeln für Tabellenrandkonflikte verwenden. |
| [setUseWord2002TableStyleRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord2002TableStyleRules-boolean) | Word‑2002‑Tabellenstilregeln emulieren. |
| [setUseWord2010TableStyleRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord2010TableStyleRules-boolean) | Gibt an, dass Word2010‑Tabellenstilregeln verwendet werden sollen. |
| [setUseWord97LineBreakRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord97LineBreakRules-boolean) | Word‑97‑Ostasiatisches Zeilenumbruchverhalten emulieren. |
| [setWPJustification(boolean value)](#setWPJustification-boolean) | WordPerfect 6.x‑Absatzausrichtung emulieren. |
| [setWPSpaceWidth(boolean value)](#setWPSpaceWidth-boolean) | Gibt an, ob die Breite eines Leerzeichens wie in WordPerfect 5.x festgelegt werden soll. |

### getAdjustLineHeightInTable() {#getAdjustLineHeightInTable}
```
public boolean getAdjustLineHeightInTable()
```


Fügt dem Dokument Rasterlinienabstand zu Zeilen in Tabellenzellen hinzu.

 **Examples:** 

Zeigt, wie das Dokument für verschiedene Versionen von Microsoft Word optimiert werden kann.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 /// 
 /// Groups all flags in a document's compatibility options object by state, then prints each group.
 /// 
 private static void printCompatibilityOptions(CompatibilityOptions options)
 {
     ArrayList enabledOptions = new ArrayList();
     ArrayList disabledOptions = new ArrayList();
     addOptionName(options.getAdjustLineHeightInTable(), "AdjustLineHeightInTable", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getAlignTablesRowByRow(), "AlignTablesRowByRow", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getAllowSpaceOfSameStyleInTable(), "AllowSpaceOfSameStyleInTable", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);

     addOptionName(options.getUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(), "UseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAnsiKerningPairs(), "UseAnsiKerningPairs", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);

     addOptionName(options.getWPSpaceWidth(), "WPSpaceWidth", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWrapTrailSpaces(), "WrapTrailSpaces", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");
     for (String optionName : disabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
 }

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);
     else
         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
 }

 **Examples:**

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

Zusätzlichen Abstand unter der Grundlinie für unterstrichenen ostasiatischen Text hinzufügen.

 **Examples:**

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

### getUICompat97To2003() {#getUICompat97To2003}
```
public boolean getUICompat97To2003()
```


True, um UI‑Funktionen zu deaktivieren, die nicht mit Word97‑2003 kompatibel sind. Standardwert ist false.

 **Remarks:** 

Steuert die Word97‑2003‑Kompatibilitätseinstellung, die UI‑Funktionen deaktiviert, die nicht mit Word97‑2003 kompatibel sind. Wenn true, wird das XML‑Element 'w:uiCompat97To2003' in den Dokumentpaket‑Teil '\\word\\settings.xml' geschrieben. Der Standardwert ist false. Wenn auf false gesetzt, wird dieses Element nicht geschrieben. Technisch ist diese Eigenschaft kein Teil der Kompatibilitätsoptionen, aber wir haben sie hier aus API‑Bequemlichkeitsgründen platziert.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### getUsePrinterMetrics() {#getUsePrinterMetrics}
```
public boolean getUsePrinterMetrics()
```


Druckermetriken verwenden, um Dokumente anzuzeigen.

 **Remarks:** 

Druckermetriken können je nach verwendetem Treiber variieren. Beispielsweise liefern die Windows‑Treiber "Microsoft OpenXPS Class Driver 2" und "Microsoft Print to PDF" leicht unterschiedliche Metriken. Daher kann sich das Layout des endgültigen Dokuments ändern, wenn diese Option aktiviert ist.

 **Examples:** 

Zeigt, wie das Dokument für verschiedene Versionen von Microsoft Word optimiert werden kann.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### setDoNotBreakConstrainedForcedTable(boolean value) {#setDoNotBreakConstrainedForcedTable-boolean}
```
public void setDoNotBreakConstrainedForcedTable(boolean value)

Zerlegen Sie Tabellenzeilen nicht um schwebende Tabellen herum.

 **Examples:** 

Zeigt, wie das Dokument für verschiedene Versionen von Microsoft Word optimiert werden kann.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### setForgetLastTabAlignment(boolean value) {#setForgetLastTabAlignment-boolean}
```
public void setForgetLastTabAlignment(boolean value)
```


Ignorieren Sie die Breite des letzten Tabstopps beim Ausrichten des Absatzes, wenn er nicht linksbündig ist.

 **Examples:** 

Zeigt, wie das Dokument für verschiedene Versionen von Microsoft Word optimiert werden kann.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 **Examples:**

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 **Examples:**

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

### setUICompat97To2003(boolean value) {#setUICompat97To2003-boolean}
```
public void setUICompat97To2003(boolean value)
```


True, um UI‑Funktionen zu deaktivieren, die nicht mit Word97‑2003 kompatibel sind. Standardwert ist false.

 **Remarks:** 

Steuert die Word97‑2003‑Kompatibilitätseinstellung, die UI‑Funktionen deaktiviert, die nicht mit Word97‑2003 kompatibel sind. Wenn true, wird das XML‑Element 'w:uiCompat97To2003' in den Dokumentpaket‑Teil '\\word\\settings.xml' geschrieben. Der Standardwert ist false. Wenn auf false gesetzt, wird dieses Element nicht geschrieben. Technisch ist diese Eigenschaft kein Teil der Kompatibilitätsoptionen, aber wir haben sie hier aus API‑Bequemlichkeitsgründen platziert.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value) {#setUsePrinterMetrics-boolean}
```
public void setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value)
```


Druckermetriken verwenden, um Dokumente anzuzeigen.

 **Remarks:** 

Druckermetriken können je nach verwendetem Treiber variieren. Beispielsweise liefern die Windows‑Treiber "Microsoft OpenXPS Class Driver 2" und "Microsoft Print to PDF" leicht unterschiedliche Metriken. Daher kann sich das Layout des endgültigen Dokuments ändern, wenn diese Option aktiviert ist.

 **Examples:** 

Zeigt, wie das Dokument für verschiedene Versionen von Microsoft Word optimiert werden kann.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {

         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
